Morelull

Grass Fairy

Alola · Generation 7

Morelull is a Grass/Fairy-type Illuminating Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.2 m tall and weighs 1.5 kg. It evolves into Shiinotic. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (75), with a base stat total of 285.
